title: LangGraph Candidate Gap Analysis
module_docstring: Isolated LangGraph deep parity runtime for Brain V9 Agent Kernel V2. Intentionally NOT wired into runtime.py, api_adapter.py, or main.py.

public_methods_found.signature: run(self, message: str, mode: str = 'read_only', user_id: str = 'probe') -> Dict[str, Any]

create_run.notes: Public API exposes run(message, mode, user_id) instead of create_run(goal, mode, user_id). api_adapter.chat_agent calls rt.create_run(...), so this method is missing for production compatibility.

execute_run.notes: No execute_run(run_id) method exists. The graph is invoked directly via run().

response_normalization.notes: LangGraph run() returns a raw final_state dict. It does not set canonical fields expected by response_normalizer.py such as final_answer, provider_metadata, mode_requested, mode_effective, etc., unless the graph nodes populate them. api_adapter would need to translate the graph output before normalization.

trace_contract.notes: Trace storage is compatible with /v2/agent/runs/{run_id}/trace contract, assuming run_root layout matches Native.

security_and_governance.strict_operator_access: api_adapter requires X-Brain-Token; LangGraph runtime itself has no auth layer.
security_and_governance.mode_enforcement: Graph includes governance_gate node using validate_mode and mode_requires_escalation. Read-only tool blocking relies on ToolGatewayV2. Same governance primitives as Native.
security_and_governance.notes: If LangGraph is wired through api_adapter, the existing require_strict_operator_access and governance primitives apply.

fallback_metadata.backend_selected: Not set on class by default; runtime.py sets it if selected.
fallback_metadata.backend_fallback_used: Not set on class by default; runtime.py sets it if selected.
fallback_metadata.backend_fallback_reason: Not set on class by default; runtime.py sets it if selected.

native_only_assumption_risks: api_adapter.chat_agent calls rt.create_run and rt.execute_run directly; LangGraph class has run() but not those methods.
api_adapter uses route_info to decide whether to call plan_run; LangGraph has no plan_run.
response_normalizer expects run dict fields that may not be present in LangGraph final_state.
Dashboard and other consumers expect backend metadata attributes (backend_selected, backend_fallback_used, backend_fallback_reason).
top_gaps: Missing create_run(goal, mode, user_id) and execute_run(run_id) methods required by production runtime interface.
LangGraph run() output needs translation/normalization before response_normalizer can produce stable schema.
LangGraph runtime is not wired into runtime.py; runtime.py will fall back to Native because compatibility check fails.
